capabilities: Render Markdown as WeChat-compatible HTML with all styles inlined
Preview the rendered article live while editing the current note
Copy the styled HTML in one click for pasting into the WeChat editor
Convert local Obsidian images to inline base64 and auto-size portrait images
Auto-number heading sections and merge consecutive images into swipeable carousels
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown editor; it renders the current note into paste-ready WeChat HTML.
extras: README is mostly in Chinese with an English summary; a browser-based version of the same renderer is available at wangsiji.github.io/qiuqiu-wechat-editor; MIT licensed; Node >= 22 is only needed for development.
motivation: The author found formatting WeChat articles by hand slow and ugly, and WeChat clears class styles on paste, so all styles are written directly into style attributes.
problem: WeChat's article editor strips class-based CSS and manual formatting there is slow, so Markdown pasted from Obsidian loses its layout.
summary: Markdown-to-HTML converter that renders notes as WeChat Official Account articles with fully inlined styles, live preview, and one-click copy.
